content.text:
Every tool this server offers you (29). Names and purposes only — call describe-capabilities again with `tools` naming the ones you want, for their full definitions and argument schemas.
  list-entities [reads only; any kind]: Summarises what a workspace holds, and reads its entities a page at a time.
  list-releases [reads only; kinds: release]: Summarises the Releases a workspace holds, and reads their paths a page at a time.
  validate [reads only; kinds: component, feature, featurerecipe, plugin, recipe, release, workload]: Checks correctness across a workspace, a Release, or one entity.
  build [writes; kinds: release]: Renders a Release into its artifacts, in memory, or to dist/ at the workspace root when sent write.
  pull [writes; kinds: release]: Resolves a Release's dependencies into the cache and writes its lockfile.
  describe [reads only; kinds: component, feature, release]: Describes a catalog entity, an entity file, or everything a Release reaches.
  get-schema [reads only; any kind]: Returns the JSON Schema for an entity or contract kind.
  explain-error [reads only; any kind]: Expands a diagnostic into the authoring fix it calls for.
  scaffold [reads only; any kind]: Drafts a starter document for an entity kind from its schema.
  import [writes; any kind]: Turns a foreign source description into draft Aggrega authoring files, written into the workspace.
  gen-catalog [writes; kinds: plugin]: Generates Plugin catalog entities from WebAssembly guests.
  describe-capabilities [reads only; any kind]: Narrows this server's tools to the ones that serve one entity kind, and returns any tool's full definition by name.
  lint [reads only; kinds: aggregate, component, feature, featurerecipe, manifest, mappinglibrary, plugin, recipe, release, schemalibrary]: Checks catalog publishing conventions over one entity or a whole Release.
  connection-at-position [reads only; kinds: aggregate, release]: Reports which connection's entry a position in an Aggregate or a Release falls inside.
  attach-candidates [reads only; kinds: aggregate, component, feature]: Reports which Features may attach to a node.
  connection-candidates [reads only; kinds: aggregate, component, feature]: Reports what an entity may connect to, socket by socket.
  insertion-point [reads only; any kind]: Locates where a new entry belongs in an authored document.
  attachment-container [reads only; kinds: aggregate, component, feature]: Reports which document and which container a Feature attachment belongs in.
  edit-document [writes; any kind]: Applies one bounded structured edit to an authored document, preserving every byte it does not touch.
  cache-status [reads only; any kind]: Reports what the on-disk caches hold.
  registry-list [reads only; any kind]: Reports the registries this workspace reaches and how each one is trusted.
  search [reads only; any kind]: Searches the local index of the configured registries.
  config-show [reads only; any kind]: Reports the configuration in force and which layer decided each setting.
  plugin-list [reads only; kinds: plugin]: Reports the plugins resolvable here and what each one says about itself.
  pin [writes; kinds: featurerecipe, recipe]: Records the content pins for an entity's external inputs in the entity.lock beside it.
  publish-entity [writes; any kind]: Publishes a catalog entity to a registry, where other people resolve it.
  publish-artifact [writes; any kind]: Publishes a standalone data artifact to a registry.
  sign-artifacts [writes; any kind]: Signs already-published artifacts and attaches each signature.
  deprecate-artifact [writes; any kind]: Withdraws an already-published artifact with a signed marker.
